generate_genres.description: Make up music genres that don't exist yet, such as 'microtonal lute dirt' or 'vegan uk rock'. Good for playlist names, band bios, game content or a daily dose of nonsense. Each run makes new ones. No API key required.
generate_genres.name: generate_genres

parameters.description: How many genres to make, 1 to 100. Defaults to 5.
parameters.name: count

genre.description: The first genre in the list, handy when you asked for just one.

genres.description: The made-up genres, e.g. 'microtonal lute dirt'. Every run makes new ones.
